inlines.v: STAGNATE, verb intransitive [Latin] 1. To cease to flow; to be motionless; as, blood stagnates in the veins of an animal; air stagnates in a close room. 2. To cease to move; not to be agitated. Water that stagnates in a pond or reservoir, soon becomes foul. 3. To cease to be brisk or active; to become dull; as, commerce stagnates; business stagnates.
